admission_conditions: Finite n; K has nonnegative off-diagonal entries and exact zero column sums; all actual state vectors are columns.
Inherited R5 positive model: x0>=0; prescribed f>=0 locally integrable; h,d>=0; pi is a simplex vector and locally absolutely continuous.
Coarse total equation uses exactly the same prescribed F=1^T f. State-dependent formation needs an additional coupling theorem.
Literal-energy exactness is mathematical input exactness, not zero physical measurement uncertainty; temperature/state/spin/source scope remains declared.
Normalized coordinate intervals retain the simplex and shared Gibbs dependencies. Coordinate extrema need not be simultaneously realizable.
All coefficient bounds hold almost everywhere over the entire needed interval; sampled endpoint data alone do not meet this condition.
Uniformization uses a constant lambda>0 dominating the actual complete A exit rates; Pminus is nonnegative and dominated by the actual stochastic P(t).
Sliding-window rho^floor bound requires the same valid family bounds on every length-H window concerned; otherwise use only individually certified block recurrences.
Common kappa>=0 is bounded by every actual v_j; rho is computed for full A after removing this common term, not for K alone.
Endpoint and full-block bounds are different outputs. Recent forcing receives no premature full-block rho.
Rational comparison uses 0<=k,b,kappa and nonnegative initial/forcing/coupling upper bounds; H>0 for a block certificate.
The exact-exponential transient expression denotes an analytical bound; it is not an upper bound on every more conservative rational bookkeeping sequence.
Mathematical acceptance does not validate dyadic rounding/source parsing/production code or establish an actual molecular physical consumer.

checks.reason: Direct differentiation of r=x-piX yields stated L,c,Qf. Their column sums vanish; Z is a fixed invariant subspace even for moving pi.
Alternating terms decrease on[0,1]; odd sum positive for m>=1. Monotone positive repeated squaring preserves both endpoint directions. Final width must be checked after squaring.
Own-weight monotonicity and other-weight antitonicity give coordinate sharp extrema for an independent weight box, while preserving Gibbs correlation only as an outer enclosure.
Direct unnormalized Gibbs ratios cancel the normalization and give exact pairwise balance. Interval dependency width is not a genuine Kpi defect.
Column off-diagonal lower rates and an exit upper bound give entrywise Pminus<=P(t); lambda domination gives nonnegative diagonals.
For column evolution the later factor acts on the left. Nonnegative ordered products dominate Pminus^m; simplex volume gives H^m/m!. The omitted infinite tail is nonnegative.
Positive/negative zero-sum decomposition establishes the Dobrushin induced-norm identity; entrywise lower columns give a lower overlap and hence an upper contraction factor.
Submultiplicativity for full blocks and Markov nonexpansiveness for the remainder give the floor exponent, with no instantaneous-gap substitution.
L-A=kappa(pi1^T-I), whose restriction to fixed Z is -kappa I. This scalar factor commutes on Z with the full time-dependent A evolution.
Duhamel integration gives qU_n+G_n Psi(H); the source is integrated over its own age. Whole-block envelope is U_n+G_n H, not the contracted endpoint.
Partitioning the lag integral into full H intervals yields Psi(H)sum(q^k)+q^n Psi(theta). Noncontractive/zero cases use explicit limiting conventions.
Positivity supplies X<=M; G_n=q_c(M_n+Fplus H)+g bounds residual forcing. Integrating the linear within-block envelope gives H U_n+G_n H^2/2 for the E forcing contribution.
For exact fixed Gibbs balance c=-h(Dpi-pi dbar); a variable in a finite interval has mean absolute deviation at most half its range.
Native application is the supplied100K para-H2 graph with A=K,kappa=0. No reactive destruction, collider density, physical consumer, production, field-wide novelty or strong no-go is inferred.

findings.evidence: The inherited R5 theorem explicitly requires nonnegative x0,f,h,d and nonnegative comparison coefficients. R6 section5 writes k<=h min(d), b<=h dbar without restating their nonnegative lower endpoints.
findings.impact: If read without the explicitly reused R5 premises, a negative k or b would invalidate e^-a<=1/(1+a) as the positive comparison update and can make the denominator nonpositive. This is excluded by the admitted inherited scope.
findings.minimal_change: Add x0,f,h,d>=0, shared prescribed F, 0<=k<=h min(d), 0<=b<=h dbar, and nonnegative upper/initial bounds immediately before the section5 recurrence.
findings.admission_effect: No core proof failure under the inherited R5 conditions; explicit conditions are required in any standalone implementation contract.

findings.evidence: The exact recurrence uses q=rho exp(-kappa H) and Psi_kappa(H), while its rational implementation upper replacement uses rho/(1+kappa H) and H.
findings.impact: The exact q-transient formula bounds the analytical envelope and actual residual; it generally does not upper-bound a more conservative rational bookkeeping sequence with a larger multiplier/source increment.
findings.minimal_change: Name the analytical sequence U_n^exp and rational sequence Uhat_n separately, or state explicitly that4.2 is a direct analytical residual bound independent of the rational stored endpoint values.
findings.admission_effect: No error in Duhamel/kernel formulas; prevent an unsupported comparison of two different upper-bound sequences.
